title: Dash-light brightness control
ask: Which control on the climate panel sets how bright the dash lights are at night?
why: Your answer to block 01.54 moved the dash-light dimming onto the Control Unit (D-567), and its stage is now designed: it dims the dash lamps, the panel's own lights and the display together, to one level. Nothing on the panel sets that level yet - the centre knob does temperature, fan speed and fan mode, and two key positions on the fourth row are spare. The answer is firmware, and for (b) also a key and its legend on the faceplate; no wire and no board changes for any of them.
options:
(a) The centre knob: hold its push for one second and turning it sets the dash-light level, shown on the panel's screen; after three seconds' rest it goes back to temperature, as the fan setting does. Costs nothing - firmware only; nothing new on the faceplate.
(b) A dash-light key in one of the two spare positions on the fourth row: each press steps the level, five steps and round again. Costs a key, its legend on the faceplate and a light behind it; uses one of the last two spare keys.
(c) No control in the car: one night level, set at commissioning and changed only from a laptop. Costs nothing; you cannot change it from the seat.
recommend: (a), unless you want a key you can find by touch in the dark - then (b).
stops: F-019's dimming control and E29.07's dimming check; the board stage (Y49) and its order (Y18) do not wait on it.
